note: Triennial election of the rural district council (ten divisions, two councillors each), polled 27 May 1908. No party labels are printed. Returned unopposed. Francis Grayson withdrew (Portadown Express, 8 May 1908, p. 5; Irish News, 6 May 1908, p. 8).
